name: smartBOX Furniture Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: A smart, spacious, one-person office pod optimized for video calls and designed for focus work. Built smart. Made to last.
about:
SmartBox Furniture Manufacturing, LLC is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with its central manufacturing facility located in nearby Tempe. The company was founded with a vision to improve workplace well-being and productivity by creating thoughtfully engineered phone booths and work pods. Ownership details and founder names have not been publicly disclosed.

The company produces a line of modular privacy solutions including office phone booths, work pods, solo booths, triple booths, and health pods. Each unit integrates square tempered sliding glass doors with sidelights, adjustable LED lighting, occupancy sensors, and an active air-circulation system with intake and exhaust fans. Acoustic PET panels are designed to reduce sound transmission by up to 35 dB. Units ship with dual power outlets, USB-C ports, and locking casters for mobility, and are designed for assembly in under one hour by two people.

SmartBox serves modern office environments, coworking operators, and commercial interiors, collaborating with architects, designers, and office furniture dealers. Notable installations include the coworking provider Kiln and the public-safety technology firm Axon, both based in the Phoenix metro area. End-users cited in testimonials include design professionals, facility managers, and operations managers who value acoustic privacy, predictable lead times, and ease of installation.

The company emphasizes its U.S.-based manufacturing as a differentiator, citing reliable lead times and consistent craftsmanship. It markets the only fully ADA-compliant work booth solution in its category, combining sustainable materials, accessibility, and a mobile design that avoids costly teardown and reassembly.
